title: Brain clearance of protein aggregates in degenerative diseases: the role of microglia and astrocytes
title_zh: 脑内蛋白聚集体清除在退行性疾病中的作用：微胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的角色
abstract: Abstract Protein aggregation and impaired clearance constitute central pathological hallmarks of numerous neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and frontotemporal dementia. Misfolded proteins, both extracellular and intracellular, disrupt proteostasis and contribute to synaptic dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and neuronal loss. Within the central nervous system, glial cells serve as the primary mediators of pathological protein clearance. Microglia detect, phagocytose, and degrade aggregated proteins. However, under chronic pathological stress, microglial function turns from clearing pathological proteins to paradoxically facilitating their spread. Astrocytes, which provide metabolic and homeostatic support for neurons, also participate in the clearance of aggregates through phagocytosis and glymphatic drainage. Critically, crosstalk between astrocytes and microglia enhances the clearance: microglia can recruit and process aggregates internalized by astrocytes, while astrocyte-derived signals modulate the microglial phagocytic activity. Aging, genetic risk factors, or sustained neuroinflammation may reduce the efficiency of glial removal of aggregates and accelerate disease progression. Understanding the cellular and molecular underpinnings of microglial and astrocytic clearance pathways is essential for developing therapies aimed at restoring proteostasis and mitigating neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: 摘要 蛋白聚集和清除受损是多种神经退行性疾病的核心病理特征，包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、运动神经元病和颞颞叶痴呆。错误折叠的蛋白质，无论是细胞外还是细胞内，都会破坏蛋白质稳态，导致突触功能障碍、神经炎症和神经元丢失。在中枢神经系统中，胶质细胞是病理蛋白清除的主要介质。微胶质细胞可以检测、吞噬并降解聚集体。然而，在慢性病理压力下，微胶质细胞的功能从清除病理蛋白转变为悖论性地促进其扩散。星形胶质细胞为神经元提供代谢和稳态支持，也通过吞噬和淋巴脑脊液清除聚集体。关键的是，星形胶质细胞与微胶质细胞之间的对话增强了清除：微胶质细胞可以招募并处理星形胶质细胞内吞的聚集体，而星形胶质细胞分泌的信号调节微胶质细胞的吞噬活性。衰老、遗传风险因素或持续的神经炎症可能降低胶质清除聚集体的效率，从而加速疾病进展。了解微胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞清除途径的细胞和分子基础，对于旨在恢复蛋白质稳态和减轻神经退行性变的治疗策略的开发至关重要。
